comments: Input facts: ego and agent1 are cars; ego is the responder and agent1 the initiator; both operate in the same direction on the same trafficway. Chosen assumptions: agent1 is approximately alongside in the left lane and makes a rightward lateral evasive action after 1 second, representing avoidance of an unspecified prior hazard. Once agent1 occupies ego's lane within 14-18 m, ego responds by escaping to a clear right lane, using an 8-12 m target-lane clearance threshold. Agent1 uses a 1-2 m target-lane clearance threshold. This arrangement requires a same-direction lane on each side of ego. Speeds are m/s and distances m. Conflict opportunity only; no collision is required.
